newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly flat, gas oil edges up 50.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly flat, gas oil edges up 50.

text.p: NWE oil products were little changed early on Friday although gas oil edged up 50 cents a tonne on futures.
Gasoline talked around $181 a tonne fob ARA for barges with swaps at $181 for July and August but $180.50 for September. "The physical market hasn't really got into gear this morning," said a broker.
Premiums for physical gas oil barges were little changed with prompt loading at parity to the IPE and July 25 cents over.
July IPE gas oil was up 50 cents at $162.25 at 0923 GMT.
High sulphur fuel was flat trading at $82 for prompt but later at $83 for a 10 day loading period.
